# hpe_morpheus_task (Data Source)

Provides a Morpheus task data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "morpheus_task" "deploy_app" {
  name = "Deploy app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the task

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
